name: Nakatta Pro
author: Mark Steere (2026) / AGP port
description: Square-board connection game (Mark Steere, 2026) — 'the long undiscovered Middle-earth between Nakatta and Minefield'. Black joins the top and bottom edges, White the left and right, with ORTHOGONAL chains only. You may never form any of three prohibited glyphs, in any reflection, rotation or colour reversal: the 2x2 'hard corner', and two 2x3 patterns — an attachment with both neighbouring rows clear, and Minefield's switch with one corner stone missing. A filled board always has a winner. No pie rule.
